narration.text: MPD Industries: specialty resins, built for scale.
Two plants, 22 reactors, nearly 83,000 tons a year.
Scale starts with storage: 2,904 pallet positions let us buy raw materials in bulk.
Jumbo-bag handling and 600 KL of underground solvent tanks keep every reactor fed, so capacity never sits idle.
Automation drives throughput: an overhead crane lifts each jumbo bag straight to the reactor charging deck.
Ten reactors up to 16 KL make polyester, alkyds, and epoxy around the clock: 4,373 tons a month.
Plant 2 adds higher-margin specialty resins, finished on automated flakers and pelletisers.
Polyamide, powder polyester, acrylic polyols, phenolics: a diversified mix worth 2,530 tons a month.
Fully automated, recipe-driven batches deliver the same quality every time, verified by our state-of-the-art QC and application labs.
Both plants run from one central control room.
Twelve blenders and 22 grade-dedicated tanks hold over 1,000 KL of finished goods, ready to ship.
Bigger buffers mean faster dispatch: about 1,500 tons packed, and over 1,600 KL in bulk.
Our heat comes from soya husk, agro-waste from the farms around Ujjain, burned in thermic heaters instead of coal.
Add 0.7 MW of rooftop solar and a zero liquid discharge effluent plant: lower energy costs, and a cleaner footprint.
This is our flywheel: scale lowers cost, lower cost wins partners, partners fill capacity, and full plants fund the next expansion.
A greenfield platform, built to compound.
MPD Industries. We innovate. We serve.
